description: Add explicit management for which accounts under an existing Plaid Item should keep syncing, using Plaid update mode account-selection editing where supported, preserving local history by default when accounts stop syncing, and surfacing institution-specific fallback guidance where in-app removal is not supported.

timing.gatingCondition: Features 14 and 15 should land first so item lifecycle state and permission-upgrade semantics are already stable.

principles: Users should be able to revisit account selection after initial onboarding where Plaid supports it
The UI must not over-promise symmetric add/remove behavior across all institutions
Institution-specific exceptions, especially Chase, should be surfaced clearly rather than hidden behind a broken generic flow
Account-selection editing is distinct from login repair and product-consent upgrade
Historical local data should remain understandable even when account sync membership changes

techStack.plaid: Link update mode with update.account_selection_enabled where supported
techStack.database: PostgreSQL account lifecycle state for active vs historical accounts plus item-level editability guidance as needed
techStack.testing: node:test integration coverage for update token creation plus manual institution validation

userStories.title: Launch account-selection editing for an existing item
acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated route exists for creating an update-mode token to edit synced accounts
Settings exposes an Edit synced accounts action only when editability has a defined source of truth
The action is separate from Fix login and Enable liabilities
OAuth resume and link session tracking continue to work for this flow
The feature defines whether editability comes from persisted item state, institution-specific rules, fallback heuristics, or a documented combination
The first shipped rule set for editability is documented in code and planning artifacts
userStories.testStrategy: Route integration test for token creation plus manual update-mode validation.

userStories.title: Reflect account-selection changes safely in local state
acceptanceCriteria: After account-selection changes, the local account set is refreshed correctly
The app distinguishes active synced accounts from locally retained historical accounts
Future sync behavior respects the updated account selection
Historical reporting remains understandable after account-selection edits
De-selected accounts are preserved as historical by default rather than being auto-purged
userStories.testStrategy: Integration tests for account refresh behavior plus manual verification on a real institution.

userStories.title: Handle institution-specific exceptions honestly
acceptanceCriteria: Institutions with limited in-app account-selection editing are identified or messaged clearly
For Chase-like cases, the UI can direct users to the bank's own permission manager when needed
The app does not promise account removal in-app when the institution does not support it through Plaid
Fallback guidance is specific enough for a parent to act on
Chase-specific removal guidance is an explicit first-release requirement
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UX review against institution-specific copy and fallback behavior.

userStories.title: Make account-selection state visible in Settings
acceptanceCriteria: Settings makes it understandable which accounts are currently active for sync
Closed or deselected accounts can remain visible as historical if the product model chooses to preserve them
Users can tell whether an institution is active, disconnected, or partially limited by institution rules
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UI verification with mixed account states.

high: Account-selection editing behavior is institution-specific, so a generic implementation may fail or mislead users without explicit exceptions
medium: Local reconciliation after account deselection is more complex when historical rows are preserved
Users may expect deselecting an account to delete its history unless the UI explains the model clearly
low: Some institutions may only need improved guidance rather than a new technical flow

preFlightChecklist: Confirm the exact Plaid update-mode parameters for account-selection editing
Decide how deselected accounts should appear locally when history is preserved
Define the source of truth for whether an item should show Edit synced accounts
Document known institution exceptions and fallback guidance before shipping the UI
Verify at least one institution supports the intended edit flow end-to-end

executionSlices.name: Slice A: Launch edit action
executionSlices.goal: Add a dedicated account-selection update-mode token flow and Settings CTA with a documented editability rule set.
notes: Keep route/action separate from reauth and liability upgrade

executionSlices.name: Slice B: Reconcile local accounts
executionSlices.goal: Introduce account-level active vs historical state so de-selected accounts stop syncing without losing household history.
notes: Future sync behavior should only treat active accounts as live membership

executionSlices.name: Slice C: Institution-aware UX
executionSlices.goal: Handle Chase and similar institutions honestly with explicit fallback guidance instead of implying symmetric in-app removal behavior.
notes: Chase removal should point to bank-managed permissions
Settings should surface partial limitations clearly
